instructions.name: add_liquidity
docs: Adds liquidity at the pool's ratio for exactly `shares`, paying each reserve's share rounded up, at
most `max_sol` and `max_tokens`. Into an empty pool the two maximums go in whole and set the price,
minting their geometric mean, at least `shares`; swaps then open in the next slot.

instructions.name: add_pair_liquidity
docs: Exactly `shares` at the pair's ratio, each side's part rounded up, at most `max_a` and `max_b`. Into an empty
pair both maximums go in whole and set the price, minting their geometric mean, at least `shares`.

instructions.name: create_pair
docs: Opens the pair of two token mints, `mint_a` the smaller address, with its first liquidity, which sets its
price. The creator's shares are the geometric mean of the two amounts. Swaps open in the next slot.

instructions.name: create_pool
docs: Opens the mint's pool with its first liquidity, which sets the opening price. The creator's shares are
the geometric mean of the two amounts. Swaps open in the next slot, the creator's included.

instructions.name: create_protocol_shard
docs: Anyone may open a fee shard; its rent stays with the PDA, which no key signs for.

instructions.name: remove_liquidity
docs: Burns `shares` for each reserve's share rounded down, at least `min_sol` and `min_tokens`. The last
shares take everything left in the pool.

instructions.name: remove_pair_liquidity
docs: Burns `shares` for each side's part rounded down, at least `min_a` and `min_b`. The last shares take everything.

instructions.name: swap_pair_exact_in
docs: Pays exactly `amount_in` of the input token (A when `a_to_b`); the fee comes off it in that token.

instructions.name: swap_pair_exact_out
docs: Receives exactly `amount_out` of the output token; the input paid is the smallest that covers it after the fee.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin only. The terms reach pools created from now on; `paused` stops new pools, nothing else.

errors.name: ConfigChanged
errors.msg: Configuration changed since the creation preview

errors.name: SwapNotOpen
errors.msg: Swaps open in the slot after liquidity goes into an empty pool

errors.name: InvalidProtocolShard
errors.msg: Protocol fee shard is out of range

errors.name: UnsupportedMint
errors.msg: This mint's transfers or vault could change outside the pool

errors.name: LaunchpadCoin
errors.msg: A coin created on the fix launchpad trades in its own market

errors.name: PairOrder
errors.msg: A pair names two different mints, the smaller address first

types.name: Config
docs: The template new pools copy their terms from. Changing it reaches only pools created later.

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops new pools only; live pools trade and take liquidity either way.

types.name: Pair
docs: A pair of two token mints, `mint_a` the smaller address. Each reserve sits in its own vault beside the
protocol's part of the fees taken in that token, which is booked here and which no instruction withdraws.

fields.name: terms
docs: Copied from the config at creation; nothing changes them afterwards.

fields.name: seeded_slot
docs: The slot liquidity last went into the empty pair. Swaps open in the slot after it.

types.name: PairReceipt
docs: Every pair action's itemized receipt. A swap moves `amount_a` and `amount_b`, the input side being what the
trader paid, fee included, and takes its fee in the input token: `protocol_fee` booked to the protocol,
`lp_fee` left in the reserves. Create, add and remove move both amounts for `shares`. Reserves, shares and the
price (B per A, scaled by 2^64) are those after the action.

types.name: Pool
docs: One pool per mint against SOL. SOL reserves sit in this account above its rent, tokens in its vault.

fields.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022: the program that owns the mint and the vault.

fields.name: terms
docs: Copied from the config at creation; nothing changes them afterwards.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares outstanding across every position.

fields.name: seeded_slot
docs: The slot liquidity last went into the empty pool. Swaps open in the slot after it.

types.name: Position
docs: A wallet's shares in one pool. There is no LP token: shares live here and move only by add and remove.

types.name: Receipt
docs: Every pool action's itemized receipt. On a buy `gross` is the SOL paid and `net` the part that bought
tokens; on a sell `gross` is the tokens' SOL value and `net` the SOL paid out. `gross` and `net` are the
SOL deposited or withdrawn on create, add and remove. The reserves and shares are those after the action.

types.name: Terms
docs: A pool's fee: `fee_bps` of the SOL side of every swap, of which `protocol_share_bps` goes to the
protocol and the rest stays in the pool for its liquidity providers.
